svg.title: Naming the intersections
svg.desc: An animation of a 4 by 4 grid of taped lines, seen from above, with you standing at the near (bottom) edge. First the bottom-left intersection, the one nearest you, is ringed and labeled (0, 0). Then x is counted 0, 1, 2, 3 along the bottom, left to right, and y is counted 0, 1, 2, 3 up the left side, away from you. Then a red line goes across 2 and away 3 to reach (2, 3), and a green line goes across 3 and away 2 to reach (3, 2), a different intersection. Finally every intersection is labeled in turn, from (0, 0) in the near corner to (3, 3) in the far corner. A panel beside it lists the six ideas, highlighting the one being shown.
svg.text: YOU stand here, at the near edge
2. x counts across, to the right

g.text: x is the first number: how far
y is the second number: how far
Across first, then away, like a
